name: m6_ear_looks_up

spec.name: m6_ear_looks_up
spec.brief: One measured human ear (SADIE II subject H5, left ear) as a filter. Morph 0 is a sound arriving from in front and below (elevation -30), Morph 1 from in front and above (+45): the pinna notch climbs from about 6.9 to 11.4 kHz, a moving notch that comes from a measurement. Q turns the head: behind at ear level under Morph 0, to the side and below under Morph 1. Emphasis 2 doubles every peak and dip about the curve's own trend, a designed choice, because a bare ear is only +/-10 dB. All twelve zeros solved, no rail imposed, no factory coefficients.
